svg.title: How Minecraft Parallax works, seen from above
svg.text: The monitor becomes a window (seen from above)
What you see on the monitor (real in-game screenshots)
pillar and house; the tree is just out of view
the tree slides into view and the house is gone

g.text: The webcam tracks your eyes. The
game always draws the view through
the monitor's edges, so it turns
Move right and you see more of the
left side, like a real window. Far
things shift with you and near things
stay put: that difference is depth.
